title: Gnomes Datapack X Resourcepack
description: Allows you to become a gnome in Minecraft!
body:
![The title of the project](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54b2239975ffdfc35c6f99a08362dd21ea327530.png)
# Gnomes & Knights Resourcepack X datapack!

### Description
![Description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e883af6157d435e45ef13d1e47122d3afbec6a7f_0.webp)
Welcome to the **Gnomes and Knights** resource pack X data pack combo! Dive into a medieval fantasy world where gnomes and knights roam the land. This combo pack transforms your Minecraft experience with gnomes! No knights for know though...

### Features
![Updates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24cff339713bd05f233321a5a5098e5365bde927_0.webp)
- **Custom Models**: Unique models for gnomes. However, knights coming soon...
- **NOT ADDED YET:** knights.
- **Gnomes**: Explore the world as a gnome as the King Crawly music trails wherever you go.

### Installation Tutorial
![Instructions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8670b687888aba80a6a6a12e08a09d02da7f57b_0.webp)
Follow these steps to set up the Gnomes and Knights resource pack and data pack combo:

1. **Installation**:
   - Download the file (`Gnomes&knights.zip`).
   - Open the zip file and extract the resourcepack (`Gnomes.zip`) into the resourcepacks folder.
   - Move the rest into the world's datapack folder or follow step 3.

2. **Activate the Resource Pack**:
   - Open Minecraft and go to `Options` > `Resource Packs`.
   - Go activate the resource pack by moving it to the `Selected Resource Packs` section.

3. **Activate the Data Pack**:
   - Create a new world or open an existing world.
   - Click on `Data Packs`.
   - Drag and drop the `Gnomes_and_Knights_DataPack.zip` file into the Minecraft window.
   - Click `Yes` when prompted to add the data pack.
   - Move the data pack to the `Selected Data Packs` section and click `Done`.
   - Run `/reload` to add the datapack.

4. **Using it**:
   - Run the command `/function gnome:become_gnome` to become a gnome.
   - You will be given a carrot on a stick titled ~~Attack~~, use it to defend yourself
   - If you want to revert back to a player, either do one of the following:
     - Click under the notification "Your now a Gnome!" the ~~(Revert)~~ text
     - Run the command `/function gnome:delete_gnome`
   - If you happen to die while being a gnome, **PLEASE** Revert back to human, otherwise you'll   still have the gnome following you.

5. **Start Your Adventure**:
   - Load your world and enjoy the new Gnomes and Knights experience!
